title: Internet Safety, Netiquette and Data Privacy

activities.title: How many red flags can you spot?
activities.intro: Look at the sample phishing email on the slide. Count the red flags, then answer the questions.

blocks.prompt: How many red flags did you find?
Type one red flag you are sure about.
The email is from refunds@bir-gov-ph.help-desk.site. Who really owns that address?
The attachment is called Refund_Form.pdf.exe. What is it really?

activities.title: Quick check: the BIR caller
activities.intro: One question. Pick the best answer.

blocks.prompt: A caller says: "This is BIR. You have a pending tax case. Pay ₱5,000 by GCash today to settle it." Best move?
options: Give your TIN so they can check your record
Hang up, verify through official BIR channels, and report the number
Post the number in the family GC and ask what to do
